capabilities: Create and validate prompt notes with required fields
Assemble prompts from five elements, variables and example blocks
Record refinement iterations with a diagnostic checklist
Search, filter and sort the prompt library in a panel and table
Export and import prompt packs as Markdown files
extras: The plugin never connects to an AI service; users copy the prepared text manually. Interface is bilingual (Spanish and English), requires Obsidian 1.8.7+, and is flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to store, validate and iteratively improve prompts that are later pasted into external AI tools.
summary: Prompt library manager that builds, validates, refines and shares AI prompt notes using a five-element method, without connecting to any AI.
